$comment: The CodeMie web stack: every agent is a stored CodeMie assistant. The ladders are the claude set's, inherited by name so the two cannot drift; the runner is lib/codemie-web/.
$why: Operator, 2026-09-28: pipeline agents as CodeMie web assistants, visible to the team once proven — a HARD REQUIREMENT, equally important as GHCP. The claude ladder ids exist in CodeMie's catalog under the same names (verified against llms.list() on 2026-09-28), so the ladder's model is passed to each chat as it is (llm_model) and checked against the catalog at pre-flight.

inheritFrom.$whyOnlyThese: The claude RUNNER is not inherited: a set declaring both runners makes `claude` routable, and resolve_primary_provider could route a codemie-web run to it.

finalFallback.$why: The claude set's fallback model, served by CodeMie: the same second answer after ladder exhaustion, on this stack.

codemie-web.$whyNoFlags: Not a command-line runner: the call is a chat with a stored assistant (lib/codemie-web/). The model travels as llm_model per chat; CodeMie's chat has no reasoning-effort parameter, so the ladder's effort is carried only by its choice of model.
codemie-web.$whyToolNames: The CodeMie Plugin tools an agent can reach. A grant of read_file/list_files/search only binds the pipeline's READ-ONLY plugin (lib/codemie-web/plugin_ro.py); write_file or bash binds the development plugin (read, list, write, git, run-command); no grant binds no plugin at all.
